title: In aviation fuel, Iowa farmers are missing a unique market | Opinion
description:
No one should be surprised by the latest reportsshowing Iowa farm income has fallen sharply.
Sustainable aviation fuel, low-carbon marine fuels, and other next-generation biofuels have the potential to create billions of gallons of new demand for American ethanol.
These markets are real; they are growing, and Iowa farmers should be leading the way in supplying them.
Four years of delay, delay, and more delay while farmers lose market opportunities that are increasingly being filled by foreign competitors.
In this case, it's a travesty for Iowa farmers and our rural economy.
text:
Tom Buis grew up on a farm, worked in the U.S. House and Senate, led the National Farmers Union, and later became the first CEO of Growth Energy.

He now serves as CEO of the American Carbon Alliance.

No one should be surprised by the latest reportsshowing Iowa farm income has fallen sharply. Commodity prices are abysmal, input costs remain high, and farm families continue to do what they've always done: Work harder, spend less, and hope next year brings better conditions.

America's farmers have never wanted to depend on government assistance. What they have always wanted is the opportunity to compete, innovate and sell more of what they produce. Throughout our history, agriculture has prospered when we've opened new markets, not when we've expanded government programs.

And the opportunity is here. Sustainable aviation fuel, low-carbon marine fuels, and other next-generation biofuels have the potential to create billions of gallons of new demand for American ethanol. Airlines are already signing long-term fuel agreements, and countries around the world are adopting low-carbon fuel standards. The global shipping industry is looking for alternatives to traditional fuels. These markets are real; they are growing, and Iowa farmers should be leading the way in supplying them.

What’s worse, is Iowa farmers could be realizing these benefits today.

Think about where we'd be today if the Summit carbon pipeline had stayed on its original schedule. Iowa ethanol producers could already be supplying planes, ships, and cars with clean, renewable biofuels, and farmers would be seeing the benefits of stronger demand instead of another year of tight or negative margins.

Four years of delay, delay, and more delay while farmers lose market opportunities that are increasingly being filled by foreign competitors. It’s been said many times: "If you snooze, you lose." In this case, it's a travesty for Iowa farmers and our rural economy.

Let America’s farmers do what they do best: Produce the safest, most abundant food, feed, and fiber. Government’s role, and regulators' role, should be to allow them to compete for new markets, not hamstring them and then send them a check to make up for the markets they lose.

This debate has never really been about one pipeline. It's about whether Iowa intends to lead the next chapter of American agriculture or watch other states or countries seize the opportunity first. Every major economic advancement has faced opposition, and there will always be those who oppose new infrastructure, ethanol, carbon capture, or modern agriculture itself. But when projects that create new markets are delayed indefinitely, it isn't just private companies that lose. It's farm families, ethanol plants, rural communities and the whole state economy.

The greatest opportunity for rural America isn't another government handout. It's creating new markets for the crops our farmers already grow. That's how rural America has always prospered: not through government checks, but through innovation, investment and new customers.

The rest of the world is moving. The question is whether Iowa will seize this opportunity or continue allowing delay, bureaucracy and obstruction to leave our farmers behind.

Tom Buis grew up on a farm, worked in the U.S. House and Senate, led the National Farmers Union, and later became the first CEO of Growth Energy. He now serves as CEO of the American Carbon Alliance.

text:
Innovative Modular Platform for Synthetic Aviation Fuel

Boston-based clean-fuel developer Lydian has secured $43 million in Series A funding to advance the commercialization of its modular production platform designed to significantly reduce the cost and complexity of synthetic aviation fuel manufacturing. The funding round was led by Breakthrough Energy Ventures, with participation from AP Ventures, Builders Vision, and existing investors. This capital injection will accelerate the deployment of PIVOT, Lydian’s integrated system that combines proprietary reactors, catalysts, process engineering, software, and plant equipment into standardized, factory-built modules.

Lydian asserts that its platform can cut plant capital costs by more than 50% compared to conventional synthetic fuel production methods, while achieving up to a 95% reduction in lifecycle emissions. Unlike most synthetic fuel projects that rely on adapting gas-to-liquids technologies for large, centralized facilities, Lydian’s purpose-built reactors are engineered to operate efficiently with renewable electricity, accommodate fluctuating power prices, and support smaller, modular installations.

Joe Rodden, CEO and Co-founder of Lydian, emphasized the distinctiveness of the approach: “PIVOT represents a fundamentally different approach to synthetic fuel production. By designing every part of the system for lower capital costs, greater operational flexibility, and faster deployment, we’ve created a platform for commercially competitive synthetic fuel projects. This financing gives us the resources to bring that vision to market.”

Flexibility and Standardization to Drive Cost-Effective Production

The PIVOT platform integrates reactor technologies and catalysts with advanced software that dynamically adjusts operations in response to intermittent renewable power availability. This operational flexibility enables facilities to increase production when electricity prices are low, addressing one of the most significant cost drivers in synthetic fuel manufacturing.

The system’s factory-built, pre-engineered modules are intended to reduce project risk and shorten development timelines by up to two years by minimizing site-specific engineering and simplifying construction processes. Standardization facilitates repeatable plant designs that can be deployed across multiple locations. The platform is designed to produce ASTM-approved, drop-in sustainable aviation fuel compatible with existing aircraft and fuel infrastructure.

Carmichael Roberts of Breakthrough Energy Ventures highlighted the importance of this innovation for the aviation sector: “Decarbonizing aviation will require advanced fuels that compete on cost, work within today’s aviation infrastructure, and deliver the performance flyers and airlines expect. Lydian is taking on that challenge with a purpose-built approach to synthetic aviation fuel production. Its PIVOT platform combines strong technical innovation with a practical path to better project economics, offering the aviation industry a low-carbon fuel capable of cost-competitive, commercial-scale production.”

Development Timeline and Industry Challenges

Lydian currently operates a tonne-scale pilot plant at its Boston research center and plans to establish a commercial demonstration facility by 2028, followed by its first full-scale commercial project by 2030. The recent funding will support the transition from pilot operations to commercial deployment.

Despite the promising technology, the path to widespread adoption faces several challenges. Regulatory hurdles, substantial initial investment requirements, and the necessity for extensive testing and validation to ensure safety and efficiency may slow progress. Additionally, market skepticism from traditional fuel suppliers and airlines could pose obstacles, while competitors may intensify efforts to develop alternative technologies such as hybrid-electric generators and other sustainable aviation fuels. The ultimate success of Lydian’s reactor technology will depend on overcoming these barriers and securing broad industry acceptance.

If successful, the PIVOT platform could provide airlines and fuel producers with a lower-cost, scalable method for synthetic fuel production, reducing dependence on conventional jet fuel supply chains and supporting domestic fuel production near renewable energy sources.

Αναδεικνύει και ένα λιγότερο συζητημένο ζήτημα: την ανάγκη ανάπτυξης εναλλακτικών καυσίμων για τις δραστηριότητες που δεν μπορούν εύκολα να ηλεκτροδοτηθούν.

Όπως επισημαίνει το περιοδικό TIME, το κλείσιμο της κρίσιμης θαλάσσιας οδού έχει περιορίσει όχι μόνο τις εξαγωγές αργού πετρελαίου και φυσικού αερίου, αλλά και τη μεταφορά διυλισμένων προϊόντων, από τα καύσιμα αεροσκαφών μέχρι τα καύσιμα μαγειρέματος.

Η απότομη άνοδος των τιμών και η έντονη μεταβλητότητα θα μπορούσαν θεωρητικά να αποτελέσουν ισχυρό κίνητρο για την ανάπτυξη εναλλακτικών λύσεων. Στην πράξη, όμως, οι ίδιες συνθήκες που καθιστούν τις επενδύσεις περισσότερο αναγκαίες αυξάνουν ταυτόχρονα το οικονομικό ρίσκο για τις επιχειρήσεις.

Η εξάρτηση της Ευρώπης από τα καύσιμα του Κόλπου

Χαρακτηριστικό παράδειγμα αποτελεί η αγορά των αεροπορικών καυσίμων. Πριν από την κρίση, εκατοντάδες χιλιάδες βαρέλια jet fuel περνούσαν καθημερινά από τα Στενά του Ορμούζ.

Η Ευρώπη είναι ιδιαίτερα εκτεθειμένη, καθώς περισσότερο από το 40% των εισαγωγών αεροπορικών καυσίμων της προερχόταν το 2025 από τον Περσικό Κόλπο, σύμφωνα με στοιχεία της S&P Global που επικαλείται το TIME.

Η διατάραξη αυτών των ροών απειλεί πλέον όχι μόνο τα περιθώρια κέρδους των αεροπορικών εταιρειών, αλλά και τη συνολική ασφάλεια εφοδιασμού της ευρωπαϊκής αεροπορικής αγοράς.

Εναλλακτικές λύσεις υπάρχουν ήδη. Τα βιώσιμα αεροπορικά καύσιμα, γνωστά ως Sustainable Aviation Fuel ή SAF, παράγονται από πρώτες ύλες όπως χρησιμοποιημένα μαγειρικά έλαια, φυτικά προϊόντα ή συνθετικές διαδικασίες και μπορούν να αναμειχθούν με τα συμβατικά καύσιμα αεροσκαφών.

Η χρήση τους περιορίζει τις εκπομπές άνθρακα σε ολόκληρο τον κύκλο ζωής του καυσίμου, χωρίς να απαιτείται ριζική αλλαγή στους κινητήρες ή στις υφιστάμενες υποδομές των αεροδρομίων.

Μικραίνει η διαφορά τιμής

Μέχρι πρόσφατα, το βασικό εμπόδιο ήταν το κόστος. Τα SAF ήταν συνήθως τρεις έως πέντε φορές ακριβότερα από τα συμβατικά αεροπορικά καύσιμα.

Η εκτίναξη, όμως, των τιμών του jet fuel εξαιτίας της κρίσης στο Ορμούζ έχει περιορίσει σημαντικά αυτή τη διαφορά. Τα βιώσιμα καύσιμα κοστίζουν πλέον περίπου 1,5 έως δύο φορές περισσότερο από τα συμβατικά.

Η εξέλιξη αυτή ενισχύει τη μακροπρόθεσμη οικονομική λογική των εναλλακτικών καυσίμων. Δεν αρκεί, ωστόσο, για να προκαλέσει άμεσα ένα νέο κύμα επενδύσεων.

Οι αεροπορικές εταιρείες, των οποίων τα κέρδη πιέζονται ήδη από το αυξημένο κόστος καυσίμων, δύσκολα μπορούν να δεσμευθούν σε μακροχρόνια συμβόλαια αγοράς SAF σε υψηλότερες τιμές. Τέτοιες συμφωνίες είναι συνήθως απαραίτητες για να εξασφαλίσουν οι παραγωγοί τη χρηματοδότηση νέων εγκαταστάσεων.

Χωρίς σαφείς κανονιστικές υποχρεώσεις ή κρατικές εγγυήσεις, τα στελέχη των αεροπορικών εταιρειών έχουν ελάχιστα κίνητρα να αναλάβουν ένα πρόσθετο κόστος εν μέσω γεωπολιτικής αβεβαιότητας.

Αλλά και οι εταιρείες διύλισης, παρότι απολαμβάνουν υψηλά περιθώρια κέρδους, εμφανίζονται επιφυλακτικές. Η έντονη διακύμανση των τιμών τις οδηγεί να επικεντρώνονται στη βελτίωση των υφιστάμενων μονάδων και στην εκτέλεση των ήδη προγραμματισμένων έργων, αντί να αναλαμβάνουν νέες μεγάλες επενδύσεις.

Το «ασφάλιστρο» της ενεργειακής ασφάλειας

Σε κρατικό επίπεδο, πάντως, η εξίσωση είναι διαφορετική. Η υψηλότερη τιμή των εναλλακτικών καυσίμων μπορεί να αντιμετωπιστεί όχι μόνο ως κόστος για την απανθρακοποίηση, αλλά και ως ένα είδος ασφαλίστρου ενεργειακής ασφάλειας.

Η ανάπτυξη εγχώριας ή περιφερειακής παραγωγής SAF θα μπορούσε να προστατεύσει τις οικονομίες από μελλοντικές κρίσεις σε κρίσιμες θαλάσσιες οδούς, μειώνοντας την εξάρτηση από συγκεκριμένες περιοχές και προμηθευτές.

Η Ευρωπαϊκή Ένωση έχει ήδη θεσπίσει υποχρεωτικούς στόχους για τη χρήση SAF από τις αεροπορικές εταιρείες, παρά τις αντιδράσεις του κλάδου. Η κρίση στο Ορμούζ ενισχύει τώρα τα επιχειρήματα όσων θεωρούν ότι οι σχετικές εντολές δεν αποτελούν μόνο περιβαλλοντική πολιτική, αλλά και μέτρο στρατηγικής ανθεκτικότητας.

Στις ΗΠΑ, αντίθετα, η συζήτηση παραμένει στάσιμη. Τα φορολογικά κίνητρα μπορούν να περιορίσουν μέρος του κόστους, δεν αρκούν όμως από μόνα τους για τη δημιουργία νέων μονάδων παραγωγής, δικτύων μεταφοράς και υποδομών αποθήκευσης.

Το ζήτημα δεν αφορά μόνο την αεροπορία. Τα καύσιμα αντιστοιχούν σχεδόν στο 80% της τελικής κατανάλωσης ενέργειας παγκοσμίως, ενώ σημαντικό τμήμα των μεταφορών, της βαριάς βιομηχανίας και της ναυτιλίας δεν μπορεί να στραφεί άμεσα στον ηλεκτρισμό.

«Δεν έχουμε σημειώσει αντίστοιχη επιτυχία στην παραγωγή οικονομικά προσιτών και επεκτάσιμων καυσίμων χαμηλών εκπομπών άνθρακα που θα αντικαταστήσουν το πετρέλαιο», αναφέρει ο Ernie Moniz, πρώην υπουργός Ενέργειας των ΗΠΑ και επικεφαλής του Energy Futures Initiative.

Η κρίση στο Ορμούζ καθιστά σαφέστερη την επιχειρηματική και στρατηγική ανάγκη. Το ερώτημα είναι εάν κυβερνήσεις και επιχειρήσεις θα επενδύσουν εγκαίρως ή εάν, μόλις αποκλιμακωθούν οι τιμές, η συζήτηση θα αναβληθεί μέχρι την επόμενη ενεργειακή κρίση.

text:
산업혁신연구

2026, vol.42, no.2, pp. 66-78 (13 pages)

DOI : 10.22793/indinn.2026.42.2.005

발행기관 : 경성대학교 산업개발연구소

Jinsuk Choi 1

1Korea Investment Corporation

초록 열기/닫기 버튼

This study examines capital market reactions to sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) disclosure events across Korean and Japanese airlines. [Design/Methodology] Employing the Brown and Warner (1985) market model event study as the primary method and supplementary difference-in-differences (DID) panel analysis, we analyze 21 SAF-related events across six airlines from 2020 to 2025. Robustness is assessed using a three-factor specification that augments the market model with exchange rate and Brent crude oil returns, and event clustering bias is examined under five alternative event specifications. [Findings] Both Korean (mean CAR(−1,+1)=−1.27%, p=0.063) and Japanese (−1.22%, p=0.079) SAF contract disclosures generate marginally significant negative short-term abnormal returns, indicating a universal cost-signaling effect regardless of policy environment. However, an asymmetric long-run pattern emerges: Korean airlines exhibit persistent negative CARs at wider windows (CAR(−10,+10)=−6.47%, p<0.001), while Japanese airlines reverse to positive (CAR(−10,+10)=+2.61%, p<0.001). Cross-border spillover effects are directionally positive but statistically insignificant at event-level aggregation (p=0.183). Supplementary DID analysis suggests higher Q_proxy for full-service carriers post-2024 (β=+0.246, p=0.024), though merger confounds limit causal inference. [Implications] SAF disclosures are universally processed as short-term cost burdens, but long-run value recovery depends on the maturity of national policy frameworks. These findings inform policymakers that regulatory certainty can mitigate the capital market penalty associated with SAF adoption.

STARLUX has launched direct flights between Taipei (TPE) and Václav Havel Airport Prague (PRG) operated with Airbus A350-900 aircraft. From September 1, the airline will operate the route with the Airbus A350-1000, featuring 350 seats in a four-class configuration.

The operation includes two aircraft painted with the AIRSORAYAMA design in Silver and Gold, created by Japanese artist Hajime Sorayama, according to the company in a statement. The Czech capital thus joins the group of three destinations where these aircraft operate on a regular basis, alongside Tokyo Narita and Phoenix.

“Prague is much more than STARLUX Airlines' first European destination; it represents a step forward in our long-term global network development strategy,” said Glenn Chai, the company's CEO. “With the continued development of semiconductor manufacturing in Central Europe, especially around Prague, launching a direct flight will allow us to better respond to the growing demand for business travel,” he added.

STARLUX is launching direct flights between Taipei (TPE) and Václav Havel Airport Prague (PRG).

The Airbus A350-900 will operate, and from September 1 the A350-1000 with 350 seats in a four-class configuration (First, Business, Premium Economy and Economy) will be introduced.

The AIRSORAYAMA livery is a special design in two versions (Silver and Gold) created by Japanese artist Hajime Sorayama and will be seen regularly in Prague.

Services to Prague will operate with 2% sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), and the airline is working to develop a low-emissions aviation supply chain in collaboration with Taiwanese energy companies.

Yes, the airline intends to launch flights to Barcelona (Spain) and Zurich (Switzerland).

text:
Dhaka : Environment, Forest, and Climate Change Minister Abdul Awal Mintoo has called for stronger efforts to protect the Sundarbans, saying the survival of Bengal tigers depends on conserving the country's largest mangrove forest.

"Conserving tigers means conserving the Sundarbans. If the Sundarbans is not protected, there will be no tiger," Mintoo said at an event held at Ban Bhaban in Dhaka marking Global Tiger Day 2026.

The event was organized by the Bangladesh Forest Department in collaboration with IUCN Bangladesh.

Mintoo said protecting tiger habitats is crucial for maintaining ecological balance, describing the Bengal tiger as a key species that helps preserve the forest's food chain. He noted that the Sundarbans is now Bangladesh's only remaining natural habitat for the animal.

Highlighting government conservation initiatives, the minister said a National Green Mission has been launched to protect forests, wildlife, biodiversity, and the environment. The minister said the government is preparing a 10-year integrated resource management plan for the Sundarbans covering 2026-2035 and is also developing a National Tiger Recovery Program.

He said, tiger numbers in the Sundarbans have increased due to conservation measures taken by the Forest Department.

text:
The Prime Minister visited the passenger terminal at around 11 am, launched the airport at 11:30 am and will also lay the foundation stone, inaugurate and dedicate multiple development projects worth over Rs 17,900 crore in Andhra Pradesh.

Bhogapuram Airport key features

-Overall cost: Over Rs 5,640 crore

-Passenger capacity: 60 lakh on an annual basis in Phase 1, expandable to 4 crore

-Passenger facilities: Self-baggage drop, contact boarding bridges and Common Use Passenger Processing System (CUPPS)

-Technology: AI-enable operations, automated baggage handling and biometric passenger processing.

-Runway: 3,800 metre Code-E runway for wide-body aircraft like Boeing 777 and Airbus A330.

-Sustainable features: 5MV solar plant, EV charging, rainwater harvesting and energy-efficient systems.

What passengers can expect?

Designed to deliver a seamless travel experience, the airport combines advanced technology with modern passenger facilities. As per PIB, it has been equipped with Artificial Intelligence, Airside 4.0 technologies, Building Information Modelling (BIM), biometric passenger processing, Airport Predictive Operations Centre (APOC) and automated baggage handling systems to boost efficiency and passenger convenience. Smart surveillance systems to speed up passenger processing.

Built for the future

The airport’s master plan allows capacity to expand from 60 lakh to 4 crore passengers annually. It is among the fastest-completed Greenfield international airports in India, have been completed around five months ahead of schedule. The airport has also received DGCA aerodrome licence and other mandatory safety and environmental clearances, as per PTI.

Ahead of the launch, Prime Minister Narendra Modi wrote in a post on X that the airport is a “modern, future-ready airport designed to boost research, commerce and tourism.” He further added that “sustainability and fuel efficiency principles have been incorporated into this project.”

Boost for North Andhra Pradesh

Beyond improving air connectivity, the airport is likely to boost tourism, trade and exports across North Andhra. As per PTI, it will include a 25,000 metric-tonne annual cargo terminal with cold-chain facilities for pharmaceuticals, perishable goods and marine products. Better connectivity is also expected to benefit tourist destinations such as Araku, Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram, Lambasingi and Srikakulam.

The terminal’s design reflects Andhra Pradesh’s cultural heritage, with its roof inspired by Chuttilu cottages, the graceful movement of flying fish and the landscapes of Araku Valley, as per PIB.

‘Dream come true’ for Andhra Pradesh

Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu Kinjarapu described the airport as a “dream come true for people of Andhra Pradesh” in a post on X.

“Watching this vision transform into reality over the past 24 months has been truly inspiring. Today, it stands as a symbol of aspiration, perseverance and progress-opening new horizons for North Andhra and the entire state,” he stated.

In another post, the minister highlighted that Bhogapuram Airport has “already started making records even before its inauguration”. He congratulated the 13,000 tribal girls whose Dhimsa (Thinsa) dance performance earned a Guinness World Record, calling it “a proud moment for Andhra Pradesh”.

Banjarbaru, S Kalimantan (ANTARA) - Coordinating Minister for Political and Security Affairs Djamari Chaniago said forest and land fires in South and Central Kalimantan can be contained through inter-agency cooperation and weather-modification operations.

“Looking at the hotspots in Central and South Kalimantan, I am optimistic these fires can be put out because support is fully available and all necessary resources can be deployed,” he said Saturday.

The government has prepared response measures ranging from surveillance operations to weather modification, which can begin once atmospheric conditions are suitable for cloud seeding, he said.

Related news: BNPB ensures coordinated action for Central Kalimantan wildfires

Related news: Govt bolsters wildfire control preparedness in South Kalimantan

Weather modification operations can be conducted in the afternoon if conditions permit. If opportunities arise at night, authorities need only coordinate with airport officials for aircraft to conduct cloud-seeding operations.

Weather modification is vital to accelerating fire suppression, as cloud seeding could help extinguish hotspots, prevent fires from spreading and minimize environmental damage, he said.

Fighting forest and land fires is a shared responsibility requiring support from the government, security forces, volunteers, media and public, Djamari said, stressing the direct impact on human safety.

Related news: Government tackles 63 forest fires in East Kalimantan

He urged the public to support firefighting efforts and refrain from obstructing officers working in the field.

Djamari also urged agencies including the Regional Disaster Mitigation Agency (BPBD) and Manggala Agni forest-fire brigade to strengthen coordination and accelerate suppression efforts in both provinces.

title: ESGIN Investasi Green Project Pertanian - Dunia Energi
description:
BANDAR LAMPUNG – PT ESGIN Global Partners resmi memperkuat komitmennya dalam pengembangan ekonomi hijau di Indonesia melalui investasi pada sektor pertanian dan industri pengolahan singkong di Provinsi Lampung.
Kolaborasi tersebut menjadi langkah strategis untuk membangun ekosistem ekonomi hijau yang menghubungkan sektor pertanian, industri pengolahan, investasi, teknologi digital, hingga pasar karbon dalam satu rantai nilai yang terintegrasi.
Melalui kerja sama tersebut, PT ESGIN Global Partners menegaskan perannya sebagai Green Project Investor dan Green Economy Infrastructure Developer yang akan mengembangkan proyek ekonomi hijau secara menyeluruh, mulai dari penyusunan Feasibility Study investasi proyek, pembangunan infrastruktur, implementasi Digital Measurement, Reporting and Verification (Digital MRV), pengembangan proyek karbon, hingga monetisasi Carbon Credit dan Green Asset.
Di sektor pertanian, ESGIN bersama HKTI Provinsi Lampung akan mendorong penerapan Climate Smart Agriculture (CSA), Biochar for Climate-Smart Agriculture, serta Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) di lahan sawah.
Menurut Yayang, kolaborasi tersebut menjadi contoh nyata bagaimana investasi hijau mampu menghubungkan sektor pertanian, industri, teknologi, dan pembiayaan dalam satu ekosistem ekonomi yang berkelanjutan.
text:
BANDAR LAMPUNG – PT ESGIN Global Partners resmi memperkuat komitmennya dalam pengembangan ekonomi hijau di Indonesia melalui investasi pada sektor pertanian dan industri pengolahan singkong di Provinsi Lampung. Langkah tersebut ditandai dengan penandatanganan Nota Kesepahaman (Memorandum of Understanding/MoU) bersama Dewan Pimpinan Daerah Himpunan Kerukunan Tani Indonesia (DPD HKTI) Provinsi Lampung dan Perhimpunan Pengusaha Tepung Tapioka Indonesia (PPTTI) mengenai pengembangan Green Economy Ecosystem pada sektor pertanian dan industri pengolahan singkong.

Penandatanganan MoU dilaksanakan dalam rangkaian Musyawarah Daerah (Musda) DPD HKTI Provinsi Lampung dan pelantikan 15 Dewan Pimpinan Cabang (DPC) HKTI kabupaten se-Provinsi Lampung.

Nota Kesepahaman ditandatangani oleh Vice President & Indonesia Regional Head PT ESGIN Global Partners Yayang Ruzaldy, Ketua DPD HKTI Provinsi Lampung Rahmat Mirzani Djausal yang juga menjabat Gubernur Lampung, serta Sekretaris PPTTI yang mewakili Ketua Umum PPTTI Welly Soegiono.

Kolaborasi tersebut menjadi langkah strategis untuk membangun ekosistem ekonomi hijau yang menghubungkan sektor pertanian, industri pengolahan, investasi, teknologi digital, hingga pasar karbon dalam satu rantai nilai yang terintegrasi.

Melalui kerja sama tersebut, PT ESGIN Global Partners menegaskan perannya sebagai Green Project Investor dan Green Economy Infrastructure Developer yang akan mengembangkan proyek ekonomi hijau secara menyeluruh, mulai dari penyusunan Feasibility Study investasi proyek, pembangunan infrastruktur, implementasi Digital Measurement, Reporting and Verification (Digital MRV), pengembangan proyek karbon, hingga monetisasi Carbon Credit dan Green Asset. Pada tahap awal, investasi akan difokuskan pada dua sektor utama di Provinsi Lampung.

Di sektor pertanian, ESGIN bersama HKTI Provinsi Lampung akan mendorong penerapan Climate Smart Agriculture (CSA), Biochar for Climate-Smart Agriculture, serta Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) di lahan sawah. Program tersebut ditujukan untuk meningkatkan produktivitas pertanian, memperkuat ketahanan terhadap perubahan iklim, meningkatkan kesehatan tanah, mengurangi emisi gas rumah kaca, sekaligus membuka peluang pendapatan baru melalui mekanisme Nilai Ekonomi Karbon.

Sementara di sektor industri, ESGIN bersama PPTTI akan mengembangkan Methane Removal Project pada pabrik-pabrik pengolahan tepung tapioka melalui teknologi methane capture yang mengubah limbah cair menjadi biogas sebagai energi terbarukan. Selain menekan emisi metana yang memiliki potensi pemanasan global tinggi, proyek tersebut juga berpotensi menghasilkan kredit karbon sebagai sumber pendapatan baru bagi industri.

Seluruh proyek akan didukung implementasi Digital MRV berbasis Artificial Intelligence (AI), citra satelit resolusi tinggi, Internet of Things (IoT), drone, dashboard digital, serta teknologi blockchain guna memastikan transparansi, akurasi, dan kredibilitas pengukuran emisi sesuai standar nasional maupun internasional.

Lampung dipilih sebagai lokasi awal implementasi karena memiliki ekosistem pertanian dan agroindustri yang dinilai sangat kuat. Sebagai produsen singkong terbesar di Indonesia dengan produksi sekitar 7,5 juta ton per tahun serta didukung industri pengolahan tepung tapioka yang menjadi salah satu tulang punggung ekonomi daerah, provinsi tersebut dinilai memiliki potensi besar menjadi proyek percontohan nasional pengembangan ekonomi hijau berbasis komoditas pertanian.

Program ini juga sejalan dengan implementasi Undang-Undang Nomor 16 Tahun 2016 tentang Pengesahan Paris Agreement serta Peraturan Presiden Nomor 110 Tahun 2025 tentang Penyelenggaraan Instrumen Nilai Ekonomi Karbon yang mendorong pembangunan rendah karbon, perdagangan karbon, dan pembiayaan iklim di Indonesia.

Yayang Ruzaldy, Vice President & Indonesia Regional Head PT ESGIN Global Partners, menegaskan bahwa ESGIN tidak hanya berperan sebagai pengembang proyek karbon, tetapi juga sebagai investor yang membangun infrastruktur ekonomi hijau secara menyeluruh.

Menurutnya Lampung memiliki seluruh fondasi untuk menjadi pusat Green Economy berbasis pertanian di Indonesia. ESGIN berkomitmen untuk berinvestasi pada proyek-proyek strategis yang memberikan manfaat ekonomi sekaligus manfaat lingkungan, mulai dari Climate Smart Agriculture, Biochar, hingga Methane Removal Project pada industri pengolahan tepung tapioka.

“Melalui integrasi investasi, Digital MRV, Artificial Intelligence, blockchain, Green Finance, dan Carbon Market, kami ingin menciptakan model pembangunan yang mampu meningkatkan kesejahteraan petani, memperkuat daya saing industri, dan mendukung pencapaian target Net Zero Emission Indonesia,” ungkap Yayang dalam keterangannya, Sabtu (1/8).

Menurut Yayang, kolaborasi tersebut menjadi contoh nyata bagaimana investasi hijau mampu menghubungkan sektor pertanian, industri, teknologi, dan pembiayaan dalam satu ekosistem ekonomi yang berkelanjutan.

Sebagai tindak lanjut dari Nota Kesepahaman, para pihak akan memulai penyusunan Feasibility Study, identifikasi lokasi proyek prioritas, penyusunan dokumen proyek karbon, implementasi Digital MRV, serta pengembangan skema pembiayaan hijau guna mempercepat realisasi investasi.

Kerja sama ini diharapkan menjadi model nasional pengembangan Green Project pada sektor pertanian dan agroindustri yang mampu menghasilkan manfaat ekonomi, sosial, dan lingkungan secara bersamaan, sekaligus memperkuat posisi Lampung sebagai pelopor implementasi Nilai Ekonomi Karbon di Indonesia.

text:
Coordinating Minister for Political and Security Affairs Djamari Chaniago said forest and land fires in South and Central Kalimantan can be contained through inter-agency cooperation and weather-modification operations.

“Looking at the hotspots in Central and South Kalimantan, I am optimistic these fires can be put out because support is fully available and all necessary resources can be deployed,” he said Saturday.

The government has prepared response measures ranging from surveillance operations to weather modification, which can begin once atmospheric conditions are suitable for cloud seeding, he said.

Related news: BNPB ensures coordinated action for Central Kalimantan wildfires

Related news: Govt bolsters wildfire control preparedness in South Kalimantan

Weather modification operations can be conducted in the afternoon if conditions permit. If opportunities arise at night, authorities need only coordinate with airport officials for aircraft to conduct cloud-seeding operations.

Weather modification is vital to accelerating fire suppression, as cloud seeding could help extinguish hotspots, prevent fires from spreading and minimize environmental damage, he said.

Fighting forest and land fires is a shared responsibility requiring support from the government, security forces, volunteers, media and public, Djamari said, stressing the direct impact on human safety.

Related news: Government tackles 63 forest fires in East Kalimantan

He urged the public to support firefighting efforts and refrain from obstructing officers working in the field.

Djamari also urged agencies including the Regional Disaster Mitigation Agency (BPBD) and Manggala Agni forest-fire brigade to strengthen coordination and accelerate suppression efforts in both provinces.

BERITABETA.COM – Pusat Riset Botani Terapan, Badan Riset dan Inovasi Nasional (BRIN) menyoroti kandungan bahan bakar nabati (biofuel) berbasis tanaman non-pangan pada kandungan biji buah pohon Bintanggur atau Nyamplung (Calophyllum inophyllum).

Dalam Webinar Nasional Mahasiswa Pusat Kolaborasi Riset (PKR) Biofuel Nyamplung 2026, terungkap pohon yang tumbuh subur di wilayah pesisir pada ketinggian 0–300 meter di atas permukaan laut ini memiliki keunggulan kompetitif yang sangat tinggi.

Peneliti Ahli Utama Pusat Riset Botani Terapan BRIN, Budi Leksono menjelaskan, persentase ekstraksi atau rendemen minyak dari bijinya tercatat sangat pekat, yakni berkisar antara 40 hingga 85 persen.

"Karakteristik tersebut menjadikan Nyamplung (Bintanggur-red) sebagai salah satu sumber bahan baku biodiesel dan bioavtur yang sangat menjanjikan," ujar Budi Leksono.

Dari sisi teknis kelayakan, bahan bakar biodiesel dari formulasi minyak Bintanggur ini terbukti sukses memenuhi parameter fisikokimia SNI Biodiesel.

Di tingkat riset tingkat tinggi, ekstrak minyak Bintanggur juga menunjukkan kinerja memuaskan saat diuji sebagai bahan baku Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) atau bioavtur untuk bahan bakar pesawat terbang dalam skala laboratorium.

Pemanfaatan komoditas ini tidak hanya terhenti pada pengambilan minyak di dalam bijinya. Seluruh sisa produksi dari pemrosesan minyak nyamplung dapat diolah kembali menjadi aneka produk turunan bernilai ekonomi tinggi.

Potongan ampas dan tempurungnya bisa dikonversi menjadi briket arang, pelet biomassa, kompos, pakan ternak, racikan sabun, produk kosmetik, obat herbal, hingga cairan asap cair.

"Nyamplung bukan hanya menghasilkan bahan bakar nabati, tetapi juga memberikan manfaat ekologis melalui rehabilitasi lahan dan peningkatan cadangan karbon," kata Budi Leksono.

Dari sisi habitat, pohon asli Indonesia ini sanggup bertahan hidup di lahan asin maupun tanah kritis, berbuah sepanjang tahun, serta mencatatkan angka panen mencapai 15 hingga 20 ton buah per hektare setiap tahunnya.

text:
Summary From India State Climate Investment Forum 2026

This white paper summarizes the discussion from the Clean Fuels track of the India State Climate Investment Forum 2026, focusing on the opportunities and challenges associated with scaling Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) in Maharashtra. The paper captures insights from industry leaders, technology developers, policymakers, and ecosystem stakeholders on how Maharashtra can develop a bankable SAF ecosystem and support the transition toward lower-carbon aviation.

The global aviation sector’s decarbonization pathway increasingly depends on the accelerated deployment of SAF; however, moving from ambition to commercial-scale implementation requires addressing key challenges related to project economics, feedstock availability, infrastructure, regulatory support, and demand certainty. The white paper highlights that while technology pathways such as Hydroprocessed Esters and Fatty Acids (HEFA), Alcohol-to-Jet (ATJ), co-processing, and emerging waste-based solutions are progressing, the primary challenge remains making SAF projects investable and bankable by creating reliable supply chains, securing long-term offtake agreements, and establishing supportive policy frameworks.

Maharashtra is uniquely positioned to become a SAF hub due to its strong industrial ecosystem, refinery infrastructure, port connectivity, aviation demand centers, and agricultural resources. The state’s sugar industry, availability of agricultural residues, proximity to major airports, and potential for integrated technology clusters create opportunities to develop diverse SAF pathways, including ethanol-based ATJ, waste-based fuels, and future synthetic fuel solutions.

The white paper also emphasizes that scaling SAF requires coordinated action across stakeholders. Key priorities include developing robust feedstock aggregation and reverse supply chains, creating bankable offtake structures through airlines and corporate buyers, implementing credible monitoring and reporting frameworks, and establishing streamlined approval processes. A Maharashtra SAF Coalition bringing together producers, airlines, airports, policymakers, investors, and other stakeholders could help accelerate project development and convert market interest into actionable investments.
